# HRPPI — Human Resource Productivity Partners, International

> HRPPI is a registered human resource consulting firm in Kingston, Jamaica. Tagline: "We make your people our business." HRPPI partners with businesses across Jamaica and the Caribbean to align their people, systems and culture with their business goals.

- Official name: Human Resource Productivity Partners, International (HRPPI)
- Location: Kingston, Jamaica
- Service area: Jamaica and the wider Caribbean
- Director: Shirley Bartley-Byfield — Accredited Business Communicator (ABC, IABC), MBA in Business Management, CARIMAC/UWI graduate; former senior internal communications manager at Scotiabank and former Director of Public Relations, Ministry of National Security and Justice (Jamaica)
- Contact: Hrproductivitypartner@gmail.com
- Website: https://hrproductivitypartners.com/
- Last updated: 2026-08-05

## Services

- [HR Systems Setup](https://hrproductivitypartners.com/#services): Selection and implementation of HR software so hiring, payroll, performance reviews and training live in one system instead of scattered spreadsheets.
- [Staff Training & Development](https://hrproductivitypartners.com/#services): Training programs, clear career paths, and manager and leadership coaching so businesses grow leaders from within.
- [Organizational Change Management](https://hrproductivitypartners.com/#services): Rollout planning, staff communication and manager support that makes restructures, new systems and new leadership actually stick.
- [Employee Engagement](https://hrproductivitypartners.com/#services): Fair conflict-handling processes, employer reputation building, internal communication and morale programs that keep good staff.
- [Organizational Culture](https://hrproductivitypartners.com/#services): Defining company values and identity and turning them into day-to-day habits that hold as the business grows.

## How HRPPI works

Three-step engagement model: Discover (understand the business goals and current team), Design (build the systems, programs and policies), Deliver (implement, guide the change, and make it stick). Every engagement is led by one dedicated partner per client and tailored to the client's size and budget — no off-the-shelf templates.
